Hello! I am a third-year PhD student in the Department of Statistics at Rice University, where I work with my advisor, [Dr. Meng Li](https://meng.rice.edu). I moved to Houston after graduating from Baylor University in Spring 2024.

Statistics is a powerful instrument for uncovering relationships and exploring the unanswered questions of this world, and my time at Rice has deepened my desire to understand how things work.

My research develops Bayesian methods for variable and model selection and studies the theoretical properties of ensembles, with applications in medicine and finance. One of my ongoing projects integrates insights from large language models into state-of-the-art Bayesian variable selection models, while another proposes a general Bayesian scheme for aggregating predictors.

:::
:::::

Outside of academic research, I love working with data to satisfy my various curiosities. My
[fantasy football dashboard](https://calebskinner.shinyapps.io/fantasy-dashboard/) is a deployed Shiny app that values players with BART, projecting careers and season standings. My various other exploits, span [Gas Mileage](https://github.com/CalebSkinner1/GasMileage) analysis, [Dart throws](https://calebskinner.shinyapps.io/darts-win-probability/), and [tennis rankings](https://calebskinner1.github.io/TennisGOAT/).

I am currently seeking data science and research internships for Summer 2027.

If I'm not modeling or dreaming of statistics, I like to cook with my wife, Sarah, or play a board game with some friends. I love playing tennis, watching football, and on Sunday morning, you'll find me at my church, Sojourn Montrose. I grew up in Phoenix, Arizona and will always agree to a desert hike. 🌵

For more information, check out my [GitHub](https://github.com/CalebSkinner1), [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/calebskinner1), and [CV](skinner_cv.pdf). Please feel free to reach out to me at caleb.skinner\@rice.edu!
